meta.description: Quality control for pooled CRISPR screens covering library representation, Gini index, log-skew, replicate Pearson and Spearman concordance, essentialome precision-recall AUC against CEGv2 (Hart 2017), Cas9 cut-toxicity diagnostics, copy-number amplicon detection, bottleneck propagation, MOI verification, and DepMap-style screen-quality scoring.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOI/PMID/p-values/statistics in any of the 7 outputs; all numbers trace to real computed statistics on real HAP1 TKOv3 data or clearly-labeled synthetic data.

practice_boundaries.detail: Input 6 (HER2+/ERBB2 treatment-decision framing) declined the clinical leap and disclaimed research-only scope; SKILL.md itself gives no explicit guardrail for this, flagged as a P1, not a veto trigger since the output stayed in bounds.

methodological_ground.detail: Input 3 surfaced a real sensitivity gap in the documented CN-bias Spearman threshold (false negative on a realistic 40-gene focal amplicon), but the output caveated this rather than asserting a wrong conclusion as fact; captured as a P1 recommendation.

code_usability.detail: All executed code (SKILL.md functions transcribed into run/qc_functions.py, plus the shipped examples/screen_qc.py) ran to completion with real, verifiable output on 5/5 executed inputs; no syntax errors, no missing dependencies.

functional_suitability.note: Very complete coverage of the promised scope (all 6 QC bottleneck stages documented and implemented); one correctness deduction for gaps found executing the shipped example in Input 1.

reliability.note: Weakest area: no documented input validation or error-reporting guidance anywhere; the shipped gini_index() lacks the empty-array guard present in SKILL.md's own gini() (crash risk on an all-zero-count sample).

performance_context.note: Reasonable layering across SKILL.md/usage-guide.md/examples; linear, non-redundant 10-step workflow documented in usage-guide.md.

agent_usability.note: Strong Failure-Modes/Common-Errors sections carried Inputs 2, 6, 7 correctly; one minor threshold-labeling inconsistency between SKILL.md and usage-guide.md (see P2).

human_usability.note: Natural researcher trigger phrasing throughout usage-guide.md; forgiveness scored down for the same missing-error-clarity gap noted under Reliability.

security.note: No secrets or PII handling; input validation guidance absent, mirroring the Reliability gap.

maintainability.note: Clean per-metric functions and a centralized stage_specific_thresholds() dict, but the shipped example duplicates its own, disagreeing, stage-blind thresholds instead of using it.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger and clean Related-Skills composability, but Escape Hatches scores 1/4: no practice-boundary guidance despite an in-text HER2+/ERBB2 clinical example, confirmed missing by Input 6.

key_strengths: All eight documented QC functions (library_representation, gini, replicate_concordance, essentialome_recovery, cn_bias_diagnostic, depth_audit, screen_pca, composite_qc_score) ran correctly against real HAP1 TKOv3 data and matched independently-benchmarked MAGeCK/BAGEL2/drugZ results (PR-AUC 0.996, correct essential-gene direction).

The bundled examples/screen_qc.py executes end-to-end out of the box on real MAGeCK-format count data, producing a real printed report and a real non-empty PNG plot -- gate 8 (shipped-means-present) fully satisfied.

QC thresholds correctly and dramatically caught both planted faults tested: an 8%-guide dropout (pct_zero 10.1%, depth FAIL) and a mislabeled plasmid-as-endpoint replicate plus a 50x low-depth lane (PC1/PC2 near-identical to the true plasmid sample, depth FAIL).

Extensive, literature-grounded Failure Modes and Common Errors sections (6 documented failure modes with trigger/mechanism/symptom/fix) gave the agent everything needed to answer two open-ended diagnostic prompts (PCR over-amplification, QC-threshold-gaming pressure) correctly without fabrication.

recommendations.title: CN-bias Spearman threshold misses real focal-amplicon artifacts
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md's single documented decision rule (genome-wide Spearman rho < -0.10) gives a false negative on a realistic 40-gene focal amplicon (rho=-0.066) despite a highly significant (p=7e-19), large (-0.877 vs -0.019) difference in mean LFC between amplified and diploid genes.
recommendations.root_cause: cn_bias_diagnostic() already returns amplified_mean_lfc/diploid_mean_lfc/per_bin, but SKILL.md's text names only the whole-genome correlation as 'the diagnostic threshold', without instructing a direct group-mean comparison.
recommendations.fix: Add an explicit second decision rule to the CN Bias section: compare amplified_mean_lfc to diploid_mean_lfc directly, and note that a genome-wide rho below threshold does not rule out an artifact confined to a small amplified gene set.

recommendations.title: Shipped example uses stage-blind thresholds that disagree with SKILL.md
recommendations.problem: examples/screen_qc.py applies one flat Gini band (PASS<0.2/FAIL>=0.3) and one flat correlation band to every sample regardless of plasmid vs endpoint stage, and correlates all sample pairs including plasmid-vs-endpoint, which are not real replicate pairs.
recommendations.root_cause: The bundled example was written independently of the more detailed stage_specific_thresholds()/replicate_concordance(condition_map) patterns documented later in SKILL.md.
recommendations.fix: Update examples/screen_qc.py to import stage_specific_thresholds() and restrict replicate-correlation pairs to a documented condition_map, matching SKILL.md's own functions; also add gini_index()'s missing empty-array guard (x.size==0 -> NaN) present in SKILL.md's own gini().

recommendations.title: No escape hatch for research-vs-clinical scope creep
recommendations.problem: When a request bundled legitimate screen-QC diagnosis with an individual-patient treatment decision, nothing in SKILL.md or usage-guide.md tells the agent to decline the clinical leap, despite the Skill's own text using a cancer-cell-line/HER2+ example.
recommendations.root_cause: SKILL.md has no 'When NOT to Use' or practice-boundary section.
recommendations.fix: Add an explicit note: screen QC and CN-bias diagnostics assess research cell-line data only and must never be used to confirm a biomarker for an individual patient's treatment; direct such requests to validated clinical diagnostics and a physician.

recommendations.title: Weak fault-tolerance and error-reporting guidance
recommendations.problem: Neither SKILL.md nor the shipped example documents what to do on malformed input (missing Gene/sgRNA columns, an all-zero sample, non-numeric counts); the shipped gini_index() would raise an unhandled IndexError on a fully-failed sample rather than reporting a clear error.
recommendations.root_cause: Error handling was not part of the Skill's design focus; only the happy-path computation is documented.
recommendations.fix: Add the same 'if x.size==0: return np.nan' guard to examples/screen_qc.py's gini_index, and add a short Input Validation subsection listing required columns/dtypes and the expected error/response when they are missing.

recommendations.title: Minor documented-threshold inconsistency for CN-bias Spearman rho
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md's Quantitative Thresholds table gives CN-bias Spearman rho pass at abs(rho)<0.10, while usage-guide.md's QC Decision Reference table gives abs(rho)<0.05 'post-correction' for the same metric, without stating these are different checkpoints.
recommendations.root_cause: The two tables were written at different times documenting a pre-correction fail threshold and a post-correction target without cross-referencing each other.
recommendations.fix: Label the two thresholds explicitly as 'pre-correction fail (0.10)' vs 'post-correction target (0.05)' in both files.
